conditions: Day-III Sexta walk from Jorge's exact Prima scripted placement to destination 0. Jorge remains stationary through Prima and Tercia, so the placement is the established walking origin; the placement itself is not an incoming route. On arrival he becomes inactive. At Nona a timed action deactivates him again and resets x/y/height to zero; that disappearance/reposition is not a walked segment and is not drawn. Combined character/global search-door mask 0x2f; static floor geometry, no actor or door-leaf collisions.

note.es: Día III, sexta: Jorge parte de la posición donde aguardó durante la presentación y se dirige a la celda de los monjes. Al llegar queda inactivo; su desaparición posterior no forma parte del recorrido.
note.en: Day III, Sext: Jorge leaves the position where he waited during the introduction and goes to the monks' cell. He becomes inactive on arrival; his later disappearance is not part of the route.
